open_interface_issues.action: Mechanical thermal FEA of the head TC-02, bonnet TC-04, bracket TC-12 and servo with thermal_and_loads.head_end_bc (headend_bc_<DC>_v2.csv, x0.5-2) over burn, MECO coast, relight and the 3600 s soak.
